description.text: The Llama-Doctor-3.2-3B-Instruct model is designed for text generation tasks, particularly in contexts where instruction-following capabilities are needed. This model is a fine-tuned version of the base Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model and is optimized for understanding and responding to user-provided instructions or prompts. The model has been trained on a specialized dataset, avaliev/chat_doctor, to enhance its performance in providing conversational or advisory responses, especially in medical or technical fields.

serving.notes: The card has no usage example and no system prompt. The tokenizer chat template is the Llama 3 tool template; it uses a system message only when the first message has that role. generation_config.json sets do_sample true, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.9, and max_length 131072. config.json max_position_embeddings is 131072 and _name_or_path is the parent. config.json also contains unsloth_version 2024.11.7. That string is not a stated training method. The card's file table lists pytorch_model bin shards. The repository file list is two F16 safetensors shards and no adapter_config.json. No epoch, step, learning-rate, batch-size, or LoRA rank is stated.

evaluation_reported.text: The model card reports no benchmark scores. DuFFin Table 2 lists this model name as a pirated Llama 3.2 variant with IP-ROC 1.0. The appendix table labels the same URL with Type SFT. That table does not describe a training run.
